name: IC 4012 (Webb)
blurb: IC 4012, a galaxy in the Coma Cluster, seen by Webb.
label: ic4012-webb
story: One of the large galaxies of the Coma Cluster, the nearest rich cluster of galaxies and a touchstone for measuring cosmic distances. Webb measured the surface brightness fluctuations of its starlight, a way to gauge how far away it is.

claims.text: IC 4012 is one of the large galaxies in the Coma Cluster targeted by Webb program 5989
The Coma Cluster is the nearest rich cluster and a key touchstone for the distance scale
Webb measured surface brightness fluctuations (SBF) to build a distance ladder aimed at the Hubble constant
